info.name: Tamkin
info.description:
This Postman collection is the central API reference for the Tamkin platform. It covers all endpoints for authentication, campaign management, donation payments, and media reels.

The collection is structured by feature module to reflect the backend architecture, making it easy for frontend developers to integrate.

Designed for:
- Client application integration
- API testing and payload validation
- QA and automated test pipelines

item.name: 0.System

request.description:
Checks that the server is running and reachable.

**Expected User Data**
None

Generates and returns a CSRF token. The token is also set as a cookie (`x-csrf-token`) in the response.

Call this endpoint first before making any state-changing requests (POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH). Extract the `token` from the response body and the `x-csrf-token` cookie, then include both in subsequent requests:
- Header: `x-csrf-token: <token_value>`
- Cookie: `x-csrf-token=<cookie_value>` (automatically handled by browsers/Postman)

**Expected User Data**
None – Public endpoint, no authentication required.

**Response**
`token` (string) – The CSRF token to use in the `x-csrf-token` header for subsequent requests.

item.description: System-level utility endpoints for verifying server health and connectivity.

item.name: Auth
Login & Session Management

request.description:
Authenticates or registers a user via a Google ID token. Sets session cookies on success. Returns a `status` field indicating whether the user was logged in or newly registered.

**Expected User Data**
`id_token` (string) – Required, Google OAuth2 ID token obtained from the client

Creates a new user account. Sets session cookies on success.

**Expected User Data**
`fullName` (string) – Required, full name of the user
`email` (string) – Required, valid email address
`password` (string) – Required, strong password
`confirmPassword` (string) – Required, must exactly match `password`
`nationality` (string) – Required, user's nationality

Authenticates an existing user with email and password. Sets session cookies on success.

**Expected User Data**
`email` (string) – Required, registered email address
`password` (string) – Required, account password

Clears session cookies and terminates the active session.

**Expected User Data**
None – Relies on the session cookie sent by the browser.

item.description: Handles user authentication, session creation, and session termination. Covers standard email/password login, Google OAuth, registration, and logout.

item.name: Email Verification

request.description:
Sends an OTP code to the authenticated user's email to begin the email verification flow. Requires an active session.

**Expected User Data**
None – The authenticated user is identified from the session cookie.

Verifies the user's email using the OTP received from `/auth/request-confirm-email`. Requires an active session.

**Expected User Data**
`code` (string) – Required, the OTP code sent to the user's email

item.description: Handles the two-step email verification flow. First request an OTP, then submit it to confirm ownership of the registered email address.
The Auth module manages the full user authentication lifecycle — registration, login, Google OAuth, session management, and email verification.

item.name: Campaign
Campaign Retrieval

request.description:
Returns a list of all active campaigns. Public endpoint — no authentication required.

**Expected User Data**
None

Retrieves a single campaign by its UUID. Returns the content in the appropriate language based on the request context.

**Expected User Data**
`id` (string) – Required route parameter, valid UUID of the target campaign

item.description: Read-only endpoints for browsing and fetching individual campaign records.

item.name: Campaign Management

formdata.value: Support families in Gaza with essential aid
دعم الأسر في غزة بالمساعدات الأساسية

request.description:
Creates a new donation campaign. Requires an authenticated session with ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN role.

**Expected User Data**
`title` (object, multilingual) – Required, e.g. `{ "en": "Help Gaza", "ar": "ساعد غزة" }`
`description` (object, multilingual) – Required, campaign description per supported language
`target_amount` (number) – Required, fundraising goal (min: 1, max 2 decimal places)
`current_amount` (number) – Optional, amount already raised (min: 0)
`images` (file[]) – Optional, one or more image files using field key `images`

Updates an existing campaign. All fields are optional — only provided fields will be updated. Requires ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN role.

**Expected User Data**
`id` (string) – Required route parameter, valid UUID of the target campaign
`title` (object, multilingual) – Optional, updated title per language
`description` (object, multilingual) – Optional, updated description per language
`target_amount` (number) – Optional, updated fundraising goal
`current_amount` (number) – Optional, updated amount raised
`images` (file[]) – Optional, replacement image files using field key `images`

Soft-deletes a campaign by UUID. Requires ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN role.

**Expected User Data**
`id` (string) – Required route parameter, valid UUID of the target campaign

Restores a previously soft-deleted campaign back to active state. Requires ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN role.

**Expected User Data**
`id` (string) – Required route parameter, valid UUID of the target campaign

Approves a campaign, making it publicly visible. Requires SUPER_ADMIN role only.

**Expected User Data**
`id` (string) – Required route parameter, valid UUID of the target campaign

item.description: Create, update, delete, restore, and approve campaign records. All endpoints require ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN authentication.
The Campaign module manages the full lifecycle of donation campaigns — creation, multilingual content, image uploads, status management, and approval workflow.

item.name: Payment
Payment Operations

header.description: Required. Unique key to ensure idempotent payment creation

request.description:
Initiates a donation payment for a campaign. Requires authentication and an idempotency key.

**Expected User Data**
`uuid` (string) – Required, UUID of the target campaign
`targetType` (string, enum) – Required, type of donation target. Currently only: `campaign`
`amount` (number) – Required, donation amount (min: 1)
`provider` (string, enum) – Required, payment provider. Currently: `IYZICO`

**Headers**
`idempotency-key` (string) – Required, unique key to prevent duplicate payments

header.description: Required for Stripe. Other providers use their own signature headers.

request.description:
Receives and processes payment status updates from a payment provider. This endpoint is called by the provider — NOT by the frontend.

**Expected User Data**
`provider` (string) – Required route parameter, e.g. `stripe`, `paymob`, `fawry`
Headers – Provider-specific signature header (e.g. `stripe-signature` for Stripe)
Body – Raw payload as sent by the payment provider

Simulates a provider webhook event for local development and testing. Do NOT expose or call this in production.

**Expected User Data**
`provider` (string) – Required route parameter, e.g. `stripe`, `paymob`, `fawry`
Body – Any mock payload matching the provider's webhook event format

query.description: Optional. Search by merchant reference number.
Optional. Filter by status: PENDING, SUCCEEDED, FAILED. Leave empty to skip.
Optional. Filter by provider: IYZICO. Leave empty to skip.
Optional. Filter by target UUID (e.g., campaign UUID).

request.description:
Admin endpoint to retrieve all payments with pagination and optional filters. Requires authentication.

**Query Parameters**
`search` (string) – Optional, search by merchant reference number
`status` (string, enum) – Optional, filter by payment status: PENDING, SUCCEEDED, FAILED
`provider` (string, enum) – Optional, filter by payment provider: IYZICO
`userUuid` (string) – Optional, filter by user UUID
`targetUuid` (string) – Optional, filter by target UUID (e.g., campaign UUID)
`page` (number) – Optional, page number. Default: 1
`limit` (number) – Optional, results per page. Default: 10

**Expected User Data**
None – Authenticated user is identified from the session cookie.

Retrieves the details and current status of a payment record by its ID.

**Expected User Data**
`id` (string) – Required route parameter, the payment ID or UUID

Retrieves the paginated list of payments made by the authenticated user.

**Query Parameters**
`page` (number) – Optional, page number. Default: 1
`limit` (number) – Optional, results per page. Default: 10

**Expected User Data**
None – Authenticated user is identified from the session cookie.

Admin endpoint to retrieve all payments for a specific target type and UUID. Requires ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN role.

**Expected User Data**
`target` (string, enum) – Required route parameter, target type. Currently: `campaign`
`id` (string) – Required route parameter, valid UUID of the target entity

item.name: Bank Transfer

request.description:
Returns the active bank transfer account details for donors to make manual transfers. Public endpoint — no authentication required.

**Expected User Data**
None

formdata.description: Optional. IBANs per currency as a JSON string (e.g. {"TL":"...","USD":"..."})
Optional. Whether this bank account is active
Optional. Bank account/QR image (jpeg, png, gif, webp). Max size: 10MB.

request.description:
Admin endpoint to create or update bank transfer information, including an optional image upload. All fields are optional — only provided fields will be updated. Send as multipart/form-data. Requires ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN role.

**Expected User Data**
`accountName` (string) – Optional, account holder name
`bankName` (string) – Optional, bank name
`branch` (string) – Optional, bank branch
`swiftCode` (string) – Optional, SWIFT/BIC code
`accountNo` (string) – Optional, account number
`ibans` (string) – Optional, IBANs per currency code as a JSON string (e.g. {"TL":"...","USD":"..."})
`isActive` (string) – Optional, "true" or "false"
`image` (file) – Optional, image file (jpeg, png, gif, webp). Max size: 10 MB.

item.description: Bank transfer account details for manual donations. Includes a public info endpoint and an admin update endpoint with optional image upload.
Endpoints for initiating donations, handling provider webhooks, and retrieving payment status records.

The Payment module handles donation payment flows using a pluggable provider architecture. Supports Stripe, Paymob, and Fawry. Includes idempotent webhook processing for real-time payment status updates.

item.name: User
Admin - User Management

query.description: Optional. Search by first name, last name, or email. Leave empty to skip search.
Optional. Filter by role: user, admin, super_admin. Leave empty to skip.
Optional. Filter by ban status: true or false

request.description:
Admin endpoint to list all users with filtering, search, and pagination. Requires ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN role.

**Expected User Data**
None – Admin identifies self via session cookie.

**Query Parameters**
`search` (string) – Optional, search by first name, last name, or email
`role` (string, enum) – Optional, filter by role: `user`, `admin`, `super_admin`
`isBanned` (boolean) – Optional, filter by ban status
`page` (number) – Optional, page number. Default: `1`
`limit` (number) – Optional, results per page. Default: `10`

Admin endpoint to retrieve a single user's full details by UUID. Requires ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN role.

**Expected User Data**
`uuid` (string) – Required route parameter, valid UUID of the target user

Admin endpoint to ban or unban a user. Requires ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN role.

**Expected User Data**
`uuid` (string) – Required route parameter, valid UUID of the target user
`isBanned` (boolean) – Required, set to `true` to ban, `false` to unban
`reason` (string) – Optional, reason for the ban (stored when banning)

Admin endpoint to update a user's role. Requires ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN role.

**Expected User Data**
`uuid` (string) – Required route parameter, valid UUID of the target user
`role` (string, enum) – Required, new role: `user`, `admin`, `super_admin`

Admin endpoint to update any user's data. All fields are optional. Requires ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN role.

**Expected User Data**
`uuid` (string) – Required route parameter, valid UUID of the target user
`firstName` (string) – Optional, updated first name
`lastName` (string) – Optional, updated last name
`email` (string) – Optional, updated email
`password` (string) – Optional, new password
`picture` (string) – Optional, profile picture URL
`role` (string, enum) – Optional, user role
`nationality` (string) – Optional, nationality
`emailVerified` (boolean) – Optional, email verification status
`provider` (string, enum) – Optional, authentication provider

item.description: Admin-only endpoints for user management. All endpoints require ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN authentication. Includes search, filter, ban/unban, and role management.
The User module manages user accounts and profiles. Includes public user retrieval, user management, and admin-only features like banning users and role management.

item.name: Reels
Reels Retrieval

request.description:
Returns a paginated list of all reels.

**Expected User Data**
`page` (number) – Optional, page number. Default: `1`
`limit` (number) – Optional, results per page. Default: `10`, Max: `100`

Searches reels by title, content, or uploader. Returns paginated results.

**Expected User Data**
`title` (string) – Optional, filter by reel title
`content` (string) – Optional, filter by reel caption or description
`uploadedBy` (string) – Optional, filter by uploader name or ID
`page` (number) – Optional, page number. Default: `1`
`limit` (number) – Optional, results per page. Default: `10`, Max: `100`

Retrieves a single reel record by its UUID.

**Expected User Data**
`id` (string) – Required route parameter, valid UUID of the target reel

Returns all reels uploaded by a specific user. Paginated.

**Expected User Data**
`userId` (string) – Required route parameter, valid UUID of the target user
`page` (number) – Optional, page number. Default: `1`
`limit` (number) – Optional, results per page. Default: `10`, Max: `100`

item.description: Read-only endpoints for listing, searching, and retrieving individual reel records.

item.name: Reels Management

formdata.description: Required. Video file (mp4, mkv, webm, avi, mov, m4v). Max size: 100MB.

formdata.value: A short update from the field.

request.description:
Uploads a video reel. Requires ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN role. Accepted formats: mp4, mkv, webm, avi, mov, m4v. Max file size: 100 MB.

**Expected User Data**
`file` (file) – Required, video file using field key `file`
`title` (string) – Optional, title of the reel
`content` (string) – Optional, description or caption of the reel

Updates the metadata of an existing reel. All fields are optional. Requires ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN role.

**Expected User Data**
`id` (string) – Required route parameter, valid UUID of the target reel
`title` (string) – Optional, updated reel title
`content` (string) – Optional, updated reel description or caption

Deletes a reel by its UUID. Requires ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN role.

**Expected User Data**
`id` (string) – Required route parameter, valid UUID of the target reel

item.description: Upload, update, and delete reel records. All endpoints require ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN authentication.
The Reels module manages short-form video content. Supports upload, browsing, search by title/content/uploader, and admin management operations.

item.name: Posts
Posts Retrieval

request.description:
Returns a paginated list of all published posts, newest first. Public endpoint.

**Expected User Data**
`page` (number) – Optional, page number. Default: `1`
`limit` (number) – Optional, results per page. Default: `10`

Retrieves a single post by its UUID.

**Expected User Data**
`id` (string) – Required route parameter, valid UUID of the target post

item.description: Read-only endpoints for listing and retrieving individual post records.

item.name: Posts Management

formdata.description: Required. Image file (jpeg, png, gif, webp). Max size: 10MB.

request.description:
Creates a new post with a featured image and localized title and content fields. Requires ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN role. Max image size: 10 MB.

**Expected User Data**
`file` (file) – Required, image file
`title_ar`, `title_en`, `title_tr`, `title_ur` (string) – Required, titles in different languages
`content_ar`, `content_en`, `content_tr`, `content_ur` (string) – Required, content in different languages

Updates an existing post. All fields are optional — only provided fields will be updated. Requires ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN role.

**Expected User Data**
`id` (string) – Required route parameter, valid UUID of the target post
`file` (file) – Optional, replacement image file
`title_ar`, `title_en`, `title_tr`, `title_ur` (string) – Optional, updated titles
`content_ar`, `content_en`, `content_tr`, `content_ur` (string) – Optional, updated contents

Deletes a post by its UUID. Requires ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN role.

**Expected User Data**
`id` (string) – Required route parameter, valid UUID of the target post

item.description: Create, update, and delete post records. All endpoints require ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN authentication.
The Posts module manages blog-style articles with multilingual support for title and content, alongside image attachments.
